synthesis.summary: The document contains a strong feature spine, several explicit authority and recovery safeguards, and mostly faithful narrow PlanUnits. It is not implementation-assured because one critical enum contradiction, multiple schema/path/Doctor conflicts, unsafe or undefined state transitions, evidence privacy/atomicity gaps, Docker gating contradictions, and weak PlanUnit dependency/oracle fidelity permit materially divergent builds.
